lessons.title: PSN Management Overview — Từ Contributor sang Leader
lessons.objective: Hiểu vai trò PSN Leader và management framework cốt lõi
lessons.content:
Chào mừng Chiến Binh đến Module 7! Module này là turning point của hành trình của bạn. Trước M7, bạn tập trung vào personal performance: personal connects, personal orders, personal habits. Từ M7 trở đi, bạn phải think như một LEADER.

MINI-CEO MINDSET:

PSN Leader không phải là 'người giỏi nhất' trong team. PSN Leader là người giúp cả team TRỞ NÊN GIỎI HƠN. Sự khác biệt:

❌ Contributor mindset: 'Tôi phải sell nhiều hơn, connect nhiều hơn, kiếm nhiều tiền hơn'
✅ Leader mindset: 'Làm sao để team của tôi sell nhiều hơn, connect nhiều hơn, và EVERYBODY kiếm tiền?'

RESPONSIBILITIES MATRIX:

1. SET DIRECTION
- Define PSN vision và mission (VD: 'PSN của tôi sẽ có 20 members cuối tháng, đạt 50 triệu/tháng')
- Set SMART targets cho từng member
- Communicate goals rõ ràng qua weekly meetings

2. TRACK PERFORMANCE
- Monitor Cửu Địa điểm hàng ngày
- Review individual KPIs hàng tuần
- Identify trends: ai đang tăng, ai đang giảm, ai cần support

3. DEVELOP PEOPLE
- Buddy system: pair experienced với new members
- Training: share skills trong weekly meetings
- Coaching: 1:1 sessions với members cần help

4. DRIVE GROWTH
- Recruitment: liên tục add new members
- Retention: keep existing members engaged
- Culture: build environment mà người ta muốn stay

5. MANAGE CONFLICTS
- Resolve issues giữa members
- Handle underperformance với empathy + firmness
- Celebrate wins để tạo positive momentum

FRAMEWORK 3 LAYERS:

Layer 1 — DAILY (15-30 phút/ngày):
- Scan PSN dashboard: có ai cần attention?
- Send 3-5 personal messages (không phải broadcast)
- Celebrate 1-2 wins trong PSN group

Layer 2 — WEEKLY (2-3 giờ/tuần):
- PSN meeting: 60 min structured session
- 1:1 check-ins: 15-20 min với 2-3 members
- Plan next week: goals, activities, focus areas

Layer 3 — MONTHLY (4-6 giờ/tháng):
- Performance review từng member
- Team building: offline hoặc online activity
- Recruitment push: onboard 2-3 new members
- Revenue celebration: acknowledge milestones

MINDSET CHECK:
- Tôi có đang treat PSN như một business không?
- Tôi có đang invest thời gian vào PEOPLE hay chỉ vào product?
- Nếu tôi nghỉ 1 tháng, PSN của tôi có tiếp tục grow không?

Action items ngày 1:
1. Write PSN vision statement (1 câu, ví dụ: 'PSN Sức khỏe Sài Gòn — 20 members, 50 triệu/tháng, wellness-first culture')
2. Audit current PSN: list all members, their current activity level, last connect date
3. Schedule weekly PSN meeting time block (thứ 2 hoặc thứ 3, same time mỗi tuần)

lessons.title: Setting PSN Targets — SMART Goals cho Team
lessons.objective: Thiết lập PSN targets và SMART goals cho từng member
lessons.content:
PSN mà không có targets = một nhóm người đi lang thang. Targets tạo direction, alignment, và motivation. Target không đặt = không có growth. Target đặt quá cao = demotivation.

PSN-LEVEL TARGETS (Bắt đầu từ đây):

3 metrics cốt lõi cho PSN:

1. REVENUE TARGET
- Monthly revenue goal cho toàn PSN
- Formula: (Current members × Average order value × Order frequency) × Growth multiplier
- VD: 10 members × 300K/tháng × 1.5 orders × 1.2 growth = 54 triệu/tháng
- Break down: Weekly target = Monthly / 4.2

2. MEMBERSHIP TARGET
- New members recruitment goal
- Formula: (Target PSN size - Current size) / Months remaining
- VD: Target 20 members, hiện tại 10, còn 2 tháng = 5 members/tháng = 1.25/tuần

3. ACTIVITY TARGET
- Minimum viable activity cho PSN
- Connect rate: 70%+ members connect daily
- Habit score: Average 70+ points/ngày
- Meeting attendance: 80%+ members attend weekly

INDIVIDUAL SMART TARGETS:

Mỗi member cần targets cụ thể, KHÔNG PHẢI generic. Bad: 'Tuyển dụng nhiều hơn'. Good: 'Tuyển 2 members trong 14 ngày, mỗi tuần 1 connect event'.

SMART Framework:

S — SPECIFIC: Chính xác là gì, bao nhiêu, khi nào
VD: 'Order 2 lần Droppii trong tuần này' (không phải 'bán nhiều hơn')

M — MEASURABLE: Có thể đo lường bằng con số
VD: '15 connects/ngày' (không phải 'connect đều đặn')

A — ACHIEVABLE: Thử thách nhưng reachable với effort
VD: Nếu member hiện tại làm 5 connects/ngày → target 10 là achievable
Nếu member hiện tại làm 2 connects/ngày → target 10 là STRESSPOINT

R — RELEVANT: Liên quan đến PSN goals và member's personal why
VD: Nếu member muốn kiếm 10 triệu/tháng → targets phải support điều đó

T — TIME-BOUND: Có deadline rõ ràng
VD: 'Đến thứ 6 tuần này' (không phải 'sớm thôi')

TARGET TIERING (cho new members):

Week 1-2: ONBOARDING TARGETS
- Complete product training (4 modules)
- Make 5 connects/day for 7 days
- First order: within 10 days of joining

Week 3-4: DEVELOPMENT TARGETS
- 10 connects/day
- 2 orders/week
- Attend 1 event/week
- First recruit attempt (optional)

Month 2+: PERFORMANCE TARGETS
- 15 connects/day
- 3 orders/week
- 1 recruit/month (minimum)
- Active in buddy system (if paired)

STRETCH TARGETS (cho top performers):
- 20+ connects/day
- 5+ orders/week
- 2+ recruits/month
- Running buddy sessions

TARGET REVIEW CADENCE:

WEEKLY: Quick check — có member nào đang behind target không?
BI-WEEKLY: Adjust nếu cần (member sick, family issues, etc.)
MONTHLY: Full review — set targets cho month mới
QUARTERLY: Strategic review — adjust PSN-level targets

Action items:
1. Calculate PSN monthly revenue target (base trên current members × AOV × frequency)
2. Set individual targets cho top 5 members (SMART format)
3. Create target tracking spreadsheet: member name, weekly target, actual, variance, action

lessons.title: Individual KPIs per Member — Performance Dashboard
lessons.objective: Set individual KPIs cho mỗi member và track qua dashboard
lessons.content:
Mỗi member là một data point trong PSN ecosystem. Nếu bạn không track individual KPIs, bạn sẽ không biết ai đang struggle, ai đang excel, và ai có potential để promote lên sub-leader.

5 CATEGORIES OF KPIs:

1. CONNECT KPIs (Weight: 30%)
- Daily connects target: 10-15 depending on stage
- Connect quality: meaningful conversations, not just broadcast
- Response rate: % của connects nhận được reply
- Follow-up completion: % của connects có follow-up action

2. ORDER KPIs (Weight: 25%)
- Orders per week: 2-3 minimum
- Average order value: track trending
- Customer retention: repeat customers
- New customer acquisition: new people mua lần đầu

3. RECRUITMENT KPIs (Weight: 20%)
- Recruit attempts: số người approached về opportunity
- Recruit presentations: số người nhận được full business presentation
- New recruits: số người join PSN
- Recruitment conversion rate: recruits / attempts

4. HABIT/ENGAGEMENT KPIs (Weight: 15%)
- Daily habit score: Droppii Points system
- Meeting attendance: % meetings attended
- Training completion: modules finished
- Group participation: comments, shares trong PSN group

5. LEADERSHIP KPIs (Weight: 10% — for senior members)
- Buddy sessions conducted
- New member onboarding support
- Team contributions: ideas, feedback, event hosting
- Sub-leader readiness score

KPI TIERING by Member Stage:

NEW MEMBER (Week 1-4):
- Focus: Connects + Habit score + Training
- Light: Orders + Recruitment
- Weekly review: Mandatory 1:1 với leader

DEVELOPING MEMBER (Month 2-3):
- Focus: All categories balanced
- Weekly review: Self-report + leader feedback
- Monthly deep-dive: full KPI analysis

SENIOR MEMBER (Month 4+):
- Focus: Leadership KPIs + Recruitment
- Light: Own connect/order targets (self-managed)
- Monthly review: strategic discussion, not tactical

PERFORMANCE COLOR CODING:

🟢 GREEN (On track): 80%+ of targets met consistently
→ Action: Recognize, stretch targets, delegate leadership tasks

🟡 YELLOW (At risk): 50-79% of targets met
→ Action: 1:1 coaching, identify blockers, provide support

🔴 RED (Behind): <50% of targets met for 2+ weeks
→ Action: Performance Improvement Plan (PIP), root cause analysis

EARLY WARNING SIGNALS:

Watch for these BEFORE they become problems:
- Habit score dropping 3+ days in a row
- Connect rate dropping 20%+ from baseline
- Missing meetings 2+ weeks in a row
- No orders for 14+ days (if previously active)
- Group participation suddenly stops
- 1:1 messages going unanswered for 3+ days

When you see signals: immediately reach out personally. DO NOT wait for weekly review. Personal message: 'Hey, noticed you've been quiet lately. Everything okay? I'm here if you need anything.'

DASHBOARD SETUP:

Create a simple tracking system:
- Google Sheets: Master PSN dashboard
- Columns: Name | Stage | Connects/day | Orders/wk | Habit score | Recruitment | Status
- Color coding: Green/Yellow/Red auto-highlight
- Update: Every Monday after weekly meeting

Action items:
1. List all current PSN members với stage (New/Developing/Senior)
2. Set individual KPI targets cho mỗi member theo SMART format
3. Create PSN dashboard template (Google Sheets hoặc equivalent)

lessons.title: Weekly PSN Meeting Structure — Hệ thống họp nhóm
lessons.objective: Thiết lập weekly meeting format hiệu quả và có structure
lessons.content:
Weekly PSN meeting là XƯƠNG SỐNG của PSN culture. Meeting tốt = PSN grow. Meeting tệ = PSN die. Meeting không phải là 'báo cáo công việc'. Meeting là 'rally the team, align direction, celebrate progress'.

WHY WEEKLY MEETINGS MATTER:

- ALIGNMENT: Mọi members biết PSN đang đi đâu, tuần này làm gì
- MOMENTUM: Regular touchpoints tạo discipline và consistency
- COMMUNITY: Members feel connected, không cô đơn trong journey
- LEARNING: Mỗi meeting có 1 skill share — everyone improves
- CULTURE: Cách bạn run meetings = culture bạn build

MEETING CADENCE:

Best day: Thứ 2 (start of week) hoặc Thứ 3 (after weekend reflection)
Best time: 20:00-21:00 (sau giờ làm việc, trước khi nghỉ ngơi)
Duration: 60 minutes — KHÔNG BAO GIỜ dài hơn
Frequency: Every week, NO EXCEPTIONS
Platform: Zalo Group Call hoặc Zoom

60-MINUTE STRUCTURE:

00:00-00:05 | OPENING (5 min)
- Welcome + attendance check
- Quick energy check: 'Từ 1-10, vibe của bạn hôm nay là mấy?'
- Announce agenda

00:05-00:15 | WINS CELEBRATION (10 min)
- Each member shares 1 win from last week
- Types: Order closed, new connect, personal habit win, team contribution
- Leader highlights TOP 3 wins with specific praise
- Format: 'Thứ nhất, An đạt 3 orders và 25 connects — anh thấy sự consistency rất tốt!'

00:15-00:35 | METRIC REVIEW (20 min)
- PSN Cửu Địa điểm: share current score
- Individual metrics review: mỗi member nhìn KPI của mình
- Highlight improvements: 'Hà tăng habit score từ 55 lên 72 — tuyệt vời!'
- Identify concerns: 'Minh chưa có order trong 10 ngày — Minh có cần support không?'
- NOT: shaming people who are behind
- YES: supportive, solution-oriented discussion

00:35-00:45 | TRAINING/SHARING (10 min)
- 1 skill per meeting: rotate presenters
- Topics: Objection handling, Zalo DM scripts, Product demo, Closing techniques
- Format: 5 min teach + 5 min Q&A
- Leader should prepare content cho advanced topics

00:45-00:50 | GOAL SETTING (5 min)
- Each member states 1 main goal for this week
- Leader writes them down in shared doc
- Format: 'Tuần này tôi sẽ [specific action]'

00:50-00:55 | ANNOUNCEMENTS (5 min)
- Upcoming events, training sessions, promotions
- New products, campaigns, company news
- Recognition: shoutouts, achievements, milestones

00:55-01:00 | CLOSING (5 min)
- Motivational close: quote, story, or vision reminder
- Team chant/affirmation: 'Chúng ta là Chiến Binh!' (optional but powerful)
- End on time — ALWAYS

MEETING RULES:

1. Start on time. Late members join silently, no disruption.
2. Everyone speaks. New members share first (low pressure).
3. No phone during meeting (unless taking notes).
4. Celebrate MORE than critique. Ratio: 3:1 positive to constructive.
5. Action items: every meeting ends with clear next steps for each person.
6. No side conversations. Use 'raise hand' in Zalo.
7. Leader controls time. If discussion goes long, table it for 1:1.

ZOALO-SPECIFIC TIPS:
- Pin meeting agenda 1 giờ trước
- Use Zalo Group Call (free, everyone has it)
- Record meeting for absent members (Zalo allows recording)
- Create shared Google Doc for meeting notes
- Post summary trong PSN group sau meeting (5 bullet points)

ATTENDANCE TRACKING:
- Track: Present / Absent / Late
- Absent 2+ weeks: Personal reachout
- Absent 4+ weeks: Performance review conversation
- 80%+ attendance = healthy PSN

Action items:
1. Schedule first PSN meeting: date, time, platform
2. Create 60-minute agenda template
3. Prepare 3 training topics cho next 3 meetings

lessons.title: Running Effective Meetings — Facilitation Skills
lessons.objective: Thực hành run PSN meeting như một professional facilitator
lessons.content:
Running a meeting is HARD. Anyone can schedule a Zoom call. Not everyone can run a meeting that leaves people energized, aligned, and ready to take action.

FACILITATION SKILLS:

1. OPENING ENERGY (First 2 minutes determine the entire meeting)

Bad opening: 'Alright, let's get started. Who has updates?' — kills energy immediately
Good opening: 'Chào mọi người! Tuần vừa rồi team chúng ta đạt 25 triệu, 3 recruits mới — let's celebrate! Ai có win để share?'

Energy formula:
- Start with energy HIGHER than when people joined
- Use voice: enthusiastic, varied pace, genuine excitement
- First 30 seconds: share a win or positive stat
- Make it feel like a team huddle, not a board meeting

2. MANAGING DIFFERENT PERSONALITY TYPES:

THE DOMINATOR (D-type): Talks too much, takes over discussion
→ Handle: 'That's a great point, Dũng. Let's hear from someone who hasn't spoken yet — Linh, what do you think?'

THE SHY ONE (S-type): Wants to contribute but hesitant
→ Handle: Direct but gentle: 'Lan, I'd love to hear your perspective on this. What's your take?'

THE NEGATIVE (C-type with anxiety): Points out problems without solutions
→ Handle: 'Good catch on that risk. What do you suggest we do about it?' Redirect to solutions.

THE UNPREPARED: Shows up without doing homework
→ Handle: Private 1:1 after meeting, not public callout. 'Hey, noticed you didn't have your goal ready today — everything okay?'

3. HANDLING SILENCE:

After asking a question, WAIT. Count to 5 in your head. Most people need 3-5 seconds to process.
If still silence: 'No worries if you need a moment. Let's go around the circle — Hoa, start us off?'
Never fill silence with your own words. Silence = people thinking.

4. TIME MANAGEMENT:

Set a timer for each section. Visible to everyone.
When time is up: 'We've got 2 minutes left on this section. Let's wrap it up — what's the key takeaway?'
If discussion is good but running long: 'This is important. Let's take this offline — we'll discuss in our 1:1 later today.'
If nothing is happening: Move on. Don't force engagement.

5. CONFLICT IN MEETINGS:

If two members argue:
Step 1: Acknowledge both sides — 'I hear both of you. Minh has a point about timing, and Tuấn has a point about quality.'
Step 2: Find common ground — 'We all want the PSN to succeed. Let's focus on how.'
Step 3: Table it if needed — 'This needs more discussion. Let's talk 1:1 after the meeting.'
Never let conflict spiral in front of the team.

6. MEETING FOLLOW-UP:

Within 1 hour after meeting:
- Post summary trong PSN group: 5 bullet points (wins, metrics, goals, announcements)
- Update shared doc với individual goals
- Send personal messages to members who need follow-up

Within 24 hours:
- Check in với members who were quiet/concerned
- Send resources shared in meeting
- Update dashboard với this week's targets

COMMON MEETING MISTAKES:

❌ Making it a report session (everyone reports, no discussion)
❌ Only leader talks (monologue, not dialogue)
❌ No agenda or structure (free-for-all)
❌ Running over time (respect people's time)
❌ No follow-up (meeting energy dies after call ends)
❌ Ignoring quiet members (only D-types participate)
❌ Celebrating only results, not effort (demotivates strugglers)

Action items:
1. Practice running a 60-minute meeting solo (record yourself, watch back)
2. Prepare 3 training segments (10 min each) cho upcoming meetings
3. Create post-meeting summary template (5 bullet points)

lessons.title: Buddy System Implementation — Hệ thống học việc
lessons.objective: Setup buddy system để tạo accountability và accelerate member growth
lessons.content:
Buddy system là một trong những highest-impact interventions bạn có thể làm cho PSN. Một good buddy relationship có thể giúp new member retain 3x lâu hơn và reach performance targets 2x nhanh hơn.

WHY BUDDY SYSTEM WORKS:

- ACCOUNTABILITY: 'Tôi phải report cho buddy của tôi' = stronger commitment
- SOCIAL CONNECTION: New member có người để hỏi, không cảm thấy lonely
- KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER: Senior member share shortcuts, tips, mindset
- CULTURE: Creates bonds trong PSN — people stay vì relationships, không chỉ vì product

BUDDY PAIRING STRATEGY:

Rule #1: Personality complementarity
- D-type buddy + S-type new member = D pushes, S feels supported
- S-type buddy + D-type new member = S stabilizes, D feels heard
- C-type buddy + I-type new member = C teaches systems, I brings energy

Rule #2: Stage alignment
- Best: Senior member (2+ months) paired với New member (Week 1-4)
- Avoid: Two new members paired together (both don't know enough)
- Avoid: Leader paired với anyone (leader should be above buddy system)

Rule #3: Communication style match
- Vietnamese speakers pair with Vietnamese speakers
- Age proximity: similar life stage = easier relatability
- Same city: can meet offline if desired

BUDDY SESSION STRUCTURE (Weekly, 20-30 phút):

Session flow:
1. CHECK-IN (5 min): How's your week been? Wins? Challenges?
2. HABIT REVIEW (5 min): Habit scores, connect activity, order status
3. SKILL SHARE (5-10 min): Buddy shares 1 tip/trick/insight
4. GOAL ALIGNMENT (5 min): Set buddy goals for the week ahead
5. ENCOURAGEMENT (5 min): Affirmation, motivation, prayer if applicable

BUDDY RESPONSIBILITIES:

BUDDY (Senior member):
- Reach out FIRST mỗi tuần (don't wait for new member to initiate)
- Check habit score và connect activity
- Share 1 practical tip per session
- Celebrate small wins enthusiastically
- Escalate concerns to leader (if new member struggling)
- Be PATIENT — new members make mistakes, that's how they learn

NEW MEMBER (Junior):
- Be honest về progress và challenges
- Ask questions — không có câu hỏi ngu
- Complete agreed-upon action items
- Show up consistently (attendance = respect)
- Say thank you — acknowledgment builds relationship

ACCOUNTABILITY MECHANISMS:

1. Buddy Report Card (Weekly):
- Buddy fills 3-question form:
  a) What went well this week?
  b) What needs improvement?
  c) What support do they need from leader?
- Leader reviews all reports every Monday

2. Buddy Score (Monthly):
- New member rates buddy: 1-5 on supportiveness, consistency, helpfulness
- Buddy rates new member: 1-5 on effort, engagement, growth
- Low scores trigger conversation: what's not working?

3. Buddy Matching Events (Monthly):
- PSN gathering where buddies present about each other
- 'My buddy has grown so much because...'
- Builds PSN-wide accountability culture

ESCALATION PATHS:

Level 1: Buddy → Buddy
- Normal support, encouragement, troubleshooting

Level 2: Buddy → Leader
- If new member: behind 3+ days on habit, 0 connects for 2+ days, or sharing concerns
- Leader takes over within 24 hours

Level 3: Leader → Senior Leader
- If: new member wants to quit, serious personal issue, or conflict with buddy
- Immediate response required

BUDDY SYSTEM METRICS:

Track these monthly:
- Buddy session attendance rate (target: 90%+)
- New member retention at 30 days (target: 85%+)
- New member's first order timing (target: within 14 days)
- Buddy satisfaction score (target: 4+/5)

Action items:
1. Create buddy pairs for all new members in PSN
2. Send buddy handbook (1-page guide) to all senior members
3. Schedule first buddy sessions this week

lessons.title: Week 1 Review — PSN Metrics Deep Dive
lessons.objective: Review PSN performance metrics và identify actionable insights
lessons.content:
Cuối tuần đầu tiên của Module 7, bạn cần review toàn bộ PSN performance để identify patterns, celebrate wins, và create action plans cho tuần tiếp theo.

WEEKLY REVIEW PROCESS (90 phút):

STEP 1: DATA COLLECTION (15 min)
Gather before the review:
- PSN dashboard: current Cửu Địa scores
- Individual KPI tracking sheet
- Order data: this week's orders, AOV, total revenue
- Connect data: total connects, response rates, follow-ups
- Habit data: average score, consistency rate
- Meeting attendance log
- Recruitment pipeline: prospects, presentations, new joins

STEP 2: PSN-LEVEL ANALYSIS (20 min)

Calculate Cửu Địa score:
- Connect rate: ___% (target: 70%+)
- Average habit score: ___ (target: 70+)
- Order conversion: ___% members with orders this week
- Retention: ___% active from last month
- Recruitment: ___ new members this week

Overall PSN score = weighted average
Compare to last week: trending up or down?
Compare to PSN target: gap analysis

STEP 3: INDIVIDUAL ANALYSIS (30 min)

For EACH member, review:
🟢 GREEN (On track):
- What's working? Identify the pattern.
- What stretch target can we set?
- How can they help others?

🟡 YELLOW (At risk):
- What's the gap? Specific, not vague.
- What support do they need?
- Who can help? (buddy? leader? training?)
- Set specific action items with deadline.

🔴 RED (Behind):
- Root cause analysis: WHY?
  - Knowledge gap? → Assign training
  - Motivation issue? → 1:1 motivation session
  - Personal issue? → Empathy + temporary target adjustment
  - Bad fit? → Honest conversation about fit
- Create Performance Improvement Plan (covered in M7 Day 9)
- Set weekly check-in cadence

STEP 4: PATTERN RECOGNITION (15 min)

Look for patterns across the PSN:
- Which days have highest connect activity?
- Which product sells best?
- Which objection comes up most often?
- Which training topic gets best feedback?
- Which member type performs best?

Patterns → Insights → Actions:
VD: 'Most connects happen on Thứ 2-3. Let's schedule training on Thứ 4 to capitalize on peak energy.'
VD: 'Product X sells 3x better than Y. Let's feature X more in content.'

STEP 5: ACTION PLANNING (10 min)

Create 3 types of actions:

1. INDIVIDUAL ACTIONS (per member):
- Green: Stretch target, leadership opportunity
- Yellow: Specific support plan with deadline
- Red: PIP with weekly check-ins

2. PSN ACTIONS (team-wide):
- Training topic cho next meeting
- Event to schedule
- Recruitment campaign to run
- Process improvement to implement

3. LEADER ACTIONS (your personal):
- 1:1s to schedule
- Content to create
- Skills to practice
- Network to expand

WEEKLY REVIEW TEMPLATE:

=== PSN WEEKLY REVIEW — Tuần ___ ===

PSN SCORE:
- Cửu Địa: ___/9 (last week: ___)
- Revenue: ___ triệu (target: ___)
- New members: ___ (target: ___)
- Retention: ___% (target: ___%)

TOP 3 WINS:
1. ___
2. ___
3. ___

CONCERNS:
1. ___ (action: ___)
2. ___ (action: ___)

NEXT WEEK PRIORITIES:
1. ___
2. ___
3. ___

INDIVIDUAL ACTION ITEMS:
[Table: Name | Status | Action | Deadline | Support needed]

Action items:
1. Complete your first PSN Weekly Review using the template above
2. Identify 3 patterns from this week's data
3. Create action plans for top 2 concerns

lessons.title: Data-Driven Decision Making — Dựa trên data, không phải feelings
lessons.objective: Sử dụng data để optimize PSN performance và make better decisions
lessons.content:
Data-driven PSN management là superpower của leader. Nhiều leaders make decisions based on feelings: 'Tôi cảm giác team cần training này' hoặc 'Tôi nghĩ nên giảm price'. Feelings sometimes đúng, nhưng data luôn đúng.

LEADING vs LAGGING INDICATORS:

LAGGING INDICATORS (Results — can't change them easily):
- Monthly revenue
- Total members count
- Quarterly retention rate
- Annual growth rate
→ These tell you WHAT happened, không tell you WHY
→ Use these for reporting, not for daily decisions

LEADING INDICATORS (Predictors — can influence them TODAY):
- Daily connects per member (predicts: orders in 3-7 days)
- Habit score consistency (predicts: retention in 30 days)
- Meeting attendance (predicts: PSN engagement score)
- Content engagement rate (predicts: recruitment pipeline)
- Buddy session completion (predicts: new member retention)
→ These tell you WHAT WILL happen — act on them NOW

DATA-DRIVEN DECISION FRAMEWORK:

Step 1: OBSERVE
Look at your data. What's happening?
VD: 'Revenue down 20% this week. Connects down 30%. Habit scores flat.'

Step 2: HYPOTHESIZE
Why is this happening? Form 2-3 hypotheses.
VD: 'Hypothesis 1: Members demotivated after missing targets. Hypothesis 2: Product promotion ended. Hypothesis 3: Competitor campaign distracting team.'

Step 3: TEST
Test your hypothesis with smallest possible experiment.
VD: 'I'll send motivational message + mini-contest this week. If connects increase 20%, hypothesis 1 was right.'

Step 4: MEASURE
Track the result of your experiment.
VD: 'After motivation campaign: connects up 25%, 3 new orders. Hypothesis 1 confirmed.'

Step 5: ITERATE
Apply learning to broader PSN strategy.
VD: 'Motivation works. Let's build motivation into weekly meetings as a standard practice.'

KEY METRICS TO TRACK (Daily/Weekly):

1. CONNECT PIPELINE METRICS:
- Total connects/day: track trend line
- Response rate: % connects → replies
- Appointment rate: % replies → scheduled calls
- Close rate: % appointments → orders
→ If response rate drops: content quality issue
→ If appointment rate drops: DM script issue
→ If close rate drops: product demo/closing issue

2. HABIT METRICS:
- Average daily habit score: trend over time
- Consistency: % days with score > 60
- Morning routine completion: % members starting before 8am
→ If consistency drops: accountability issue
→ If scores drop: burnout or lack of motivation

3. RECRUITMENT FUNNEL METRICS:
- Prospects identified/week
- Presentations given/week
- Decision stage: actively considering
- New joins/week
→ If presentations high but joins low: closing/presentation issue
→ If prospects low: content/awareness issue

4. FINANCIAL METRICS:
- Revenue/week: trend line
- Average order value: trend line
- Commission earned/member: distribution check
- Expenses: events, gifts, training costs
→ Revenue per member should INCREASE over time (not just member count)

A/B TESTING IN PSN:

Test ONE thing at a time:

Test 1: Connect timing
- Group A: Connect before 8am
- Group B: Connect after 8pm
- Measure: response rate after 1 week

Test 2: Message format
- Group A: Text only
- Group B: Text + image + emoji
- Measure: response rate

Test 3: Follow-up cadence
- Group A: Follow up after 1 day
- Group B: Follow up after 3 days
- Measure: conversion rate

DECISION PITFALLS TO AVOID:

❌ Survivorship bias: Only looking at top performers' data
❌ Confirmation bias: Only seeing data that confirms what you believe
❌ Small sample fallacy: Making big decisions from 1 week of data
❌ Correlation ≠ causation: 'Revenue went up after training' might be coincidence
❌ Analysis paralysis: Collecting data forever, never making decisions

Action items:
1. Set up daily tracking for 3 leading indicators (connects, habit score, response rate)
2. Run first A/B test this week (test connect timing or message format)
3. Create data review habit: 15 min every morning scanning key metrics

lessons.title: Performance Improvement Plans — Xử lý underperformance
lessons.objective: Create và execute PIPs (Performance Improvement Plans) cho struggling members
lessons.content:
Underperformance là part of running a team. Mỗi PSN sẽ có members struggle at some point. Cách bạn handle underperformance define your leadership quality.

BAD WAYS TO HANDLE UNDERPERFORMANCE:
❌ Ignore it (hy vọng nó tự sửa) — never works, wastes time
❌ Public shaming (call them out in meeting) — destroys trust
❌ Immediate termination (no chance to improve) — toxic culture
❌ Lower targets (to make them feel better) — doesn't solve root cause
❌ Do their work for them (enabling, not helping)

GOOD WAY: Structured PIP with empathy

PIP FRAMEWORK (30-Day Performance Improvement Plan):

PHASE 1: DIAGNOSIS (Day 1)

Root cause analysis — tìm ROOT CAUSE, không chỉ symptoms:

Category A: KNOWLEDGE GAP
Signs: New member, hasn't completed training, asks basic questions
Fix: Assign specific training modules, buddy support, daily check-ins

Category B: SKILL GAP
Signs: Knows the product but can't convert, makes connects but no follow-ups
Fix: Role-play sessions, script practice, shadow top performers

Category C: MOTIVATION ISSUE
Signs: Capable but not trying, inconsistent effort, 'busy' excuses
Fix: Understand personal why, reconnect to motivation, accountability buddy

Category D: PERSONAL ISSUE
Signs: Sudden drop in performance, mentions stress/family/health
Fix: Empathy first, temporary target adjustment, support resources

Category E: WRONG FIT
Signs: Joined for wrong reasons, doesn't believe in product, wants quick money only
Fix: Honest conversation: 'Is this still right for you?' Offer graceful exit

PHASE 2: PLAN CREATION (Day 1-2)

Create PIP document:

=== PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT PLAN ===
Member: [Name]
Date: [Date]
Leader: [Your name]
Duration: 30 days

CURRENT STATUS:
- Habit score: ___ (target: 70+)
- Connects/day: ___ (target: 10+)
- Orders/week: ___ (target: 2+)
- Recruitment: ___ (target: 1/month)
- Meeting attendance: ___%

ROOT CAUSE: [Diagnosis from Phase 1]

IMPROVEMENT TARGETS (30-Day):
Week 1: [Specific targets]
Week 2: [Specific targets]
Week 3: [Specific targets]
Week 4: [Specific targets]

SUPPORT PROVIDED:
- [ ] Buddy session twice/week
- [ ] Daily 1:1 check-in via Zalo
- [ ] Training module: [specific module]
- [ ] Shadow [top performer] for 1 event

CONSEQUENCES:
If targets not met after 30 days: [conversation about fit / transition / exit]

MEMBER COMMITMENT:
I commit to the above targets. Signature: ____ Date: ____
=== END PIP ===

PHASE 3: EXECUTION (Days 1-30)

Weekly structure:
- Monday: PIP review call (15 min)
- Wednesday: Mid-week check-in (5 min Zalo message)
- Friday: Progress report (buddy + self-assessment)
- Sunday: Leader review và adjust plan if needed

What to look for during PIP:
✅ Improvement trajectory (even if not at target yet)
✅ Increased effort and engagement
✅ Honest communication about struggles
✅ Responsiveness to feedback

❌ Continued decline
❌ No effort improvement
❌ Making excuses without action
❌ Disengagement from PSN activities

PHASE 4: EVALUATION (Day 30)

3 outcomes:

OUTCOME 1: IMPROVED ✅
- Member met or exceeded targets
- Celebrate! Remove PIP, set new targets
- Document what worked for future reference

OUTCOME 2: PARTIAL IMPROVEMENT ⚠️
- Member improved but not fully there yet
- Extend PIP for 15 days with adjusted targets
- Increase support intensity

OUTCOME 3: NOT IMPROVED ❌
- Member did not meet targets despite support
- Honest conversation about fit
- Offer: transition to different role, reduced commitment, or graceful exit
- Handle with DIGNITY — reputation matters

TERMINATION CONVERSATION (if needed):

Principles:
1. Private — never in front of team
2. Respectful — thank them for their effort
3. Clear — specific reasons, no ambiguity
4. Supportive — offer help transitioning
5. Forward-looking — wish them well

Template:
'[Name], tôi đánh giá cao thời gian bạn đã invest vào PSN. Sau 30 days của PIP, tôi thấy chúng ta chưa align về performance expectations. Tôi nghĩ có thể có role khác phù hợp hơn với strengths của bạn, hoặc có thể đây là lúc tốt để focus vào những thứ khác. Tôi respect quyết định của bạn và support 100% trong transition.'

Action items:
1. Identify any member in current PSN who may need PIP support
2. Create PIP template document
3. Role-play a PIP conversation with a peer or mentor

lessons.title: Team Motivation Strategies — Kích hoạt động lực nhóm
lessons.objective: Motivate PSN members hiệu quả bằng recognition, competition, và culture
lessons.content:
Motivation là FUEL của PSN. Khi members motivated, họ connect nhiều hơn, sell nhiều hơn, recruit nhiều hơn. Khi motivation die, cả PSN stagnates.

MOTIVATION THEORY (adapted cho MLM context):

Daniel Pink's Drive framework applies directly:

1. AUTONOMY — Members feel they have control
- Let members choose their connect schedule
- Allow flexibility in how they achieve targets
- Encourage personal branding (their style, not your style)

2. MASTERY — Members feel they're improving
- Progressive training: easy → medium → hard
- Celebrate skill acquisition, not just sales
- Track personal growth metrics alongside business metrics

3. PURPOSE — Members feel part of something bigger
- Connect individual effort to PSN vision
- Share customer impact stories
- Remind WHY they joined (health, freedom, family)

RECOGNITION SYSTEMS:

Recognition costs $0 nhưng value = millions. People work harder for recognition than money (after basic needs met).

DAILY RECOGNITION (5 phút):
- PSN group: 'Shoutout to [Name] — đạt 20 connects hôm nay!'
- Personal DM: '[Name], tôi thấy effort của bạn hôm nay. Keep it up!'
- Reaction: Emoji storms on good news in group

WEEKLY RECOGNITION (Meeting):
- Top connector award: 'Best Connector of the Week'
- Top order award: 'Top Sales of the Week'
- Most improved: 'Breakthrough of the Week'
- Best attitude: 'Team Spirit Award'
- Format: Public recognition + small reward (gift, voucher, shoutout)

MONTHLY RECOGNITION:
- PSN Champion: Best overall performer of the month
- Rising Star: Best improvement from new member
- MVP: Most valuable contribution (could be mentorship, events, culture)
- Reward ideas: Dinner with leader, premium product gift, feature in newsletter, bonus commission

RECOGNITION PRINCIPLES:

1. BE SPECIFIC
❌ 'Good job this week'
✅ 'An đạt 25 connects mỗi ngày trong cả tuần, consistency tuyệt vời!'

2. BE TIMELY
❌ 'You did great last month' (tháng sau)
✅ 'That close just now was amazing! Great job!' (trong moment)

3. BE PUBLIC (when appropriate)
❌ 'I appreciate you' (chỉ trong 1:1)
✅ '[Name] just closed a 2 million order — let's celebrate!' (trong group)

4. BE AUTHENTIC
❌ Generic praise that everyone gets
✅ Genuine recognition tied to real achievement

HEALTHY COMPETITION:

Competition drives performance BUT can destroy culture if mishandled.

GOOD COMPETITIONS:
✅ Connect challenge: 'Ai connect nhiều nhất trong tuần'
✅ Habit streak: 'Ai duy trì habit score 70+ nhiều ngày liên tiếp'
✅ Recruitment race: 'Ai recruit được member đầu tiên'
✅ Team vs Team: PSN A vs PSN B (fosters unity within each side)

BAD COMPETITIONS:
❌ Revenue-only: 'Ai bán nhiều nhất' — ignores effort of strugglers
❌ Humiliating: Publicly showing bottom performers
❌ Permanent ranking: Creates permanent losers
❌ Unrealistic: Prize too far out of reach

Competition rules:
- Short duration: 1 week max (not month-long)
- Multiple categories: not just revenue
- Inclusive: categories for every skill level
- Fun: atmosphere should be playful, not pressure-cooker
- Prize: meaningful but not excessive (voucher, recognition, experience)

MILESTONE CELEBRATIONS:

Mark these moments with CELEBRATION:
- First order ever: PSN group celebration + leader personal message
- First recruit: 'Welcome to the team!' announcement
- 30-day milestone: '1 month strong — here's what you've achieved'
- Habit streak: 7 days, 30 days, 100 days — badges/shoutouts
- Revenue milestone: 10 triệu, 20 triệu, 50 triệu — team celebration
- PSN growth: 10 members, 20 members, 50 members

Celebration formats:
- Zalo group: Emoji storm, congratulatory messages
- Video: 30-second celebration clip
- Offline: Team dinner, coffee meetup
- Digital: Certificate, badge, achievement post

MOTIVATION RESCUE PROTOCOL:

When a member's motivation drops:

Step 1: IDENTIFY
Signs: Missed connects, skipped meetings, low habit scores, short replies

Step 2: REACH OUT (within 24 hours)
Personal Zalo: 'Hey [Name], noticed you've been a bit off lately. Everything okay? I'm here if you need to talk.'

Step 3: LISTEN
Let them share. Don't fix immediately. Just listen.

Step 4: RECONNECT
Help them remember WHY they joined:
- Original goals: 'Remember you wanted to earn 10 triệu/month to support your family?'
- Progress made: 'You've already helped 3 customers get healthier'
- Community: 'The team misses you'

Step 5: ACTION
Together, create 1 small, achievable action for this week.
Not a big target. Something small they can actually do and feel successful.

Action items:
1. Set up daily recognition habit: 1 shoutout per day in PSN group
2. Design 1 friendly competition for next week (connect challenge or habit streak)
3. Plan milestone celebration for next member achievement

lessons.title: Conflict Management in PSN — Xử lý xung đột
lessons.objective: Resolve conflicts within PSN một cách professional và preserve relationships
lessons.content:
Conflict trong PSN là INEVITABLE. Khi bạn have 10+ people working together, có personalities khác nhau, targets khác nhau, stress levels khác nhau — conflict sẽ xảy ra. Question không phải là 'how to prevent conflict' mà là 'how to handle conflict constructively'.

COMMON CONFLICT SOURCES IN PSN:

1. COMMISSION DISPUTES
- 'Tôi giới thiệu customer nhưng người khác nhận commission'
- 'Downline của tôi chuyển sang PSN khác'
- Root: Vague rules about customer ownership và downline transfer

2. RESOURCE COMPETITION
- 'Leader favoritism: ông ấy chỉ focus vào top performers'
- 'Event budget goes to people who already have money'
- Root: Perceived unfairness in attention/resource allocation

3. PERSONALITY CLASHES
- 'Tôi không hợp với cách làm việc của [Name]'
- 'Hắn quá aggressive / quá passive / quá cầu toàn'
- Root: Different working styles, lack of DISC awareness

4. GOAL CONFLICTS
- 'Tôi muốn build team, bạn chỉ muốn sell'
- 'Tôi cần nghỉ để chăm con, team cần tôi hoạt động'
- Root: Different priorities và life stages

5. CULTURE MISALIGNMENT
- 'Người mới này không phù hợp với culture của PSN'
- 'Họ make it về người khác trong group'
- Root: Unclear PSN values và expectations

CONFLICT RESOLUTION FRAMEWORK:

STEP 1: LISTEN SEPARATELY (Before any joint conversation)

Talk to each person INDIVIDUALLY first. Never jump into mediation without understanding each side.

Listen for:
- Facts: What actually happened?
- Feelings: How does this person feel?
- Needs: What do they actually want?
- Perspective: How do they see the other person?

Rule: Listen 80%, speak 20%. Don't defend, don't argue, don't take sides.

STEP 2: IDENTIFY THE REAL ISSUE

Surface-level complaint ≠ real issue
VD: 'Hắn không respect tôi' might really mean 'Tôi cảm thấy bị忽略 trong decision-making'
VD: 'Ông ấy favoritism' might really mean 'Tôi muốn được recognition cho effort của tôi'

Ask: 'What do you actually need? Not what you're complaining about — what do you need?'

STEP 3: MEDIATION (Joint conversation)

Only bring together when:
- You understand both sides
- Both parties agree to talk
- You have a clear goal for the conversation

Mediation structure:

Opening: 'Cả hai cùng có mục tiêu tốt cho PSN. Hôm nay chúng ta discuss làm sao để align.'

Person A speaks: '[Name A], hãy share perspective của bạn. [Name B] sẽ listen, không interupt.'

Person B speaks: 'Now [Name B], same — share your perspective.'

Common ground: 'Okay, tôi thấy cả hai đều muốn PSN grow. Difference là cách tiếp cận.'

Solution brainstorming: 'Cả hai cùng nghĩ xem làm sao resolve?'

Agreement: 'Vậy chúng ta agree: [specific terms]. Let's try this for 2 weeks và review.'

STEP 4: FOLLOW UP

Within 3 days: Check in with both parties separately
'How's it going? Is the agreement working?'

Within 2 weeks: Joint check-in
'Let's review how things are going since our conversation.'

If not working: Adjust or escalate

CONFLICT PREVENTION:

Best conflict resolution = preventing conflict before it starts.

1. CLEAR RULES FROM DAY 1:
- Customer ownership policy
- Commission structure (transparent)
- Communication expectations
- Code of conduct

2. REGULAR FEEDBACK:
- Don't let issues simmer for months
- Address small issues before they become big
- 'Quick chat' culture: normal to pull someone aside for 5 min

3. CULTURAL AWARENESS:
- DISC training: help members understand each other's styles
- Team building: shared experiences build empathy
- Values alignment: regular reinforcement of PSN values

ESCALATION LADDER:

Level 1: Members resolve directly (encourage this)
Level 2: Leader mediates (most common)
Level 3: Senior leader involved (if Level 2 fails)
Level 4: Company HR (if serious — harassment, fraud, etc.)

Action items:
1. Document common conflict scenarios trong PSN và your resolution approach
2. Create simple PSN code of conduct (1 page)
3. Schedule DISC awareness session cho next PSN meeting

lessons.title: Scaling PSN — Khi nào split và cách làm
lessons.objective: Biết khi nào PSN cần split và execute transition smoothly
lessons.content:
PSN growth là goal. Nhưng khi PSN becomes quá lớn (15+ members), một single leader KHÔNG THỂ manage effectively. Time, energy, và attention là limited resources. Split là solution — không phải failure.

WHEN TO SPLIT:

Quantitative triggers:
- 15+ members trong PSN
- More than 3 sub-groups forming naturally
- Leader spending 20+ hours/week on PSN management
- Meeting attendance dropping (too many people = less participation)
- Quality of training declining (rushing through content)

Qualitative triggers:
- Members saying 'PSN feels too big, không còn close như trước'
- Natural subgroups forming with their own dynamics
- Emerging sub-leaders who are ready to lead
- Geographic spread making single meeting impractical

SPLIT PROCESS (6-week transition):

Week 1-2: IDENTIFY NEW LEADER
Criteria for new PSN Leader:
- 3+ months experience trong Droppii
- Consistent top performer (top 20% of PSN)
- Leadership qualities: initiative, empathy, reliability
- DISC preference: D or I type (natural leaders)
- Desire to lead: MUST want it, don't force
- PSN respect: members already look up to them

Selection process:
1. Leader identifies 2-3 candidates
2. Private conversation: 'I see leadership potential in you. Would you be interested in leading your own PSN?'
3. Candidate thinks it over (1 week)
4. If yes: begin preparation
5. If no: thank them, continue developing, ask again later

Week 3-4: PREPARATION

For new leader:
- Shadow current PSN meetings (observe leadership)
- Run segments of meetings (5-10 min portions)
- Take on buddy system coordination
- Learn admin tasks: tracking, dashboard, scheduling
- Meet with each member informally (build relationships)

For current PSN:
- Announce upcoming split (build excitement, not anxiety)
- Explain WHY: growth opportunity, not losing members
- Let members know they'll have CHOICE in which new PSN to join

Week 5: TRANSITION MEETING

Agenda:
1. Celebration of current PSN journey
2. Announce split details: when, how, why
3. Introduce new leader(s)
4. Explain new PSN structures
5. Member choice: which PSN do you want to join?
6. Timeline: exact dates for transition

Week 6: EXECUTION

- New PSN officially launches
- Transition handover complete
- First new PSN meeting (led by new leader)

POST-SPLIT CONNECTION:

After split, maintain relationships:
- Monthly joint events: all PSNs under same umbrella meet
- Shared training: advanced topics for all senior members
- Cross-PSN buddy system: members from different PSNs paired
- Communication: WhatsApp group for all PSN leaders

Goal: Split increases TOTAL output, không decreases it.
If total revenue goes DOWN after split: something went wrong.

SPLIT SIZE GUIDELINES:

Target: 8-12 members per PSN (after split)
Minimum: 5 members (below this, merge with another PSN)
Maximum: 15 members (above this, plan next split)
Ideal: 10 members với 2-3 emerging sub-leaders

Action items:
1. Assess current PSN size và split readiness
2. Identify 2-3 potential new leaders in your PSN
3. Have informal conversations with potential leaders about interest

lessons.title: PSN Health Dashboard Mastery — Sử dụng data để lead
lessons.objective: Master PSN health dashboard và use it for strategic decisions
lessons.content:
Dashboard không phải là để SHOW leader. Dashboard là để HELP bạn make better decisions. Nếu bạn nhìn dashboard mỗi ngày mà không thay đổi behavior, dashboard vô dụng.

PSN DASHBOARD SETUP:

Core metrics (update daily):

1. MEMBER ACTIVITY:
- Active members: ___ / Total members
- Connects today: ___ (PSN total)
- Habit score avg: ___
- Meeting attendance last meeting: ___%

2. REVENUE METRICS:
- Orders this week: ___
- Revenue this week: ___ triệu
- Revenue trend: ↑ / → / ↓
- Average order value: ___K

3. RECRUITMENT PIPELINE:
- Prospects: ___
- In presentation stage: ___
- Decision stage: ___
- New joins this month: ___

4. CỬU ĐỊA SCORE:
- Current level: ___ (Phân Phân / Tán Tán / Li Li / Kị Kị / Tranh Tranh / Nghi Nghi / Nguy Nguy / Tuyệt Tuyệt / Vô Song)
- Trend: ↑ / → / ↓
- Gap to next level: ___%

5. INDIVIDUAL STATUS:
- 🟢 Green: ___ members
- 🟡 Yellow: ___ members
- 🔴 Red: ___ members

DASHBOARD TOOLS:

Option A: Google Sheets (Recommended for beginners)
- Free, accessible, easy to share
- Create tabs: Overview, Individual Tracking, Meeting Notes
- Use conditional formatting for color coding
- Auto-calculate Cửu Địa score with formulas

Option B: Notion (For organized teams)
- Database view for each member
- Kanban board for recruitment pipeline
- Calendar for meetings and events
- Better for long-term tracking

Option C: Custom Dashboard (Advanced)
- If you have developer on team
- Real-time sync from Droppii app data
- Push notifications for alerts

CỬU ĐỊA SCORING ALGORITHM:

Formula (update weekly):

Score = (Connect_Rate × 0.25) + (Habit_Score × 0.25) + (Order_Consistency × 0.20) + (Retention × 0.15) + (Recruitment × 0.15)

Normalize each to 0-100 scale, then multiply by 0.09 to get 0-9 level.

Example calculation:
- Connect rate: 80% → 80 × 0.25 = 20
- Habit score avg: 75 → 75 × 0.25 = 18.75
- Order consistency: 70% members ordered → 70 × 0.20 = 14
- Retention: 90% → 90 × 0.15 = 13.5
- Recruitment: 2 new this month → score 60 → 60 × 0.15 = 9
Total: 75.25 → Level 7 (Nguy Nguy)

TREND ANALYSIS:

Look at 4-week trend for each metric:

📈 GROWING (3 out of 4 weeks up):
- Keep doing what you're doing
- Look for what's driving the growth — amplify it

📊 STABLE (within 10% variance):
- Good baseline
- Look for small improvements to push higher

📉 DECLINING (3 out of 4 weeks down):
- Investigate root cause immediately
- Run PIP for affected members
- Check if external factors (season, competition) are affecting

ACTION TRIGGERS (Auto-alerts):

When these happen, you MUST take action:

🔴 CRITICAL (Act within 24 hours):
- Habit score avg drops below 50
- 2+ members go RED (behind on targets)
- Revenue drops 30%+ from last week
- Member requests to quit
- PSN group becomes inactive (no messages for 48 hours)

🟡 WARNING (Act within 3 days):
- Habit score avg drops below 60
- 1 member goes RED
- Connect rate drops below 50%
- Meeting attendance below 60%
- No new recruits for 2+ weeks

🟢 HEALTHY (Monitor weekly):
- All metrics within target range
- Cửu Địa trending up
- No RED members
- Regular recruitment activity

DASHBOARD REVIEW HABIT:

Daily (5 phút):
- Scan dashboard: anything RED? → take action
- Check habit scores: anyone below 50? → personal DM

Weekly (30 phút, Sunday evening):
- Full dashboard review
- Update individual tracking
- Plan next week's focus areas

Monthly (1 giờ):
- Full analysis: trends, patterns, insights
- Strategic adjustments: targets, processes, focus
- Report to upline if applicable

Action items:
1. Set up PSN dashboard (Google Sheets template)
2. Calculate current Cửu Địa score for your PSN
3. Set up auto-alerts cho critical metrics

lessons.title: M7 Graduation — PSN Management Ready
lessons.objective: Review và consolidate PSN management skills trước khi lên M8
lessons.content:
Chúc mừng! Bạn đã hoàn thành Module 7 — PSN Management. Module này là bước ngoặt từ individual contributor sang team leader. Trước khi lên M8 (Coaching), hãy review những gì bạn đã học và create action plan cho 90 ngày tới.

M7 RECAP — KEY TAKEAWAYS:

1. PSN LEADER MINDSET
- You are a mini-CEO, not just a top salesperson
- Success = PSN success, không chỉ personal success
- Invest in people FIRST, results will follow

2. TARGETS & KPIs
- SMART targets cho PSN-level và individual-level
- 5 KPI categories: Connects, Orders, Recruitment, Habits, Leadership
- Color coding: 🟢Green 🟡Yellow 🔴Red for quick assessment
- Track leading indicators, not just lagging

3. MEETINGS
- Weekly 60-min structure: Wins → Metrics → Training → Goals → Announcements
- Facilitation skills: energy management, personality handling
- Follow-up within 1 hour post-meeting

4. BUDDY SYSTEM
- Pair senior với new members
- Weekly 20-30 min buddy sessions
- 3-level escalation path
- Track buddy metrics: attendance, satisfaction, retention

5. DATA-DRIVEN MANAGEMENT
- Leading vs lagging indicators
- A/B testing trong PSN
- Decision framework: Observe → Hypothesize → Test → Measure → Iterate
- Avoid decision pitfalls (survivorship bias, confirmation bias, etc.)

6. PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT
- PIP framework: 30-day structured improvement plan
- 5 root cause categories: Knowledge, Skill, Motivation, Personal, Fit
- Termination conversations: private, respectful, dignified

7. CONFLICT RESOLUTION
- Listen separately → Identify real issue → Mediate → Follow up
- Prevention > Resolution: clear rules, regular feedback
- 4-level escalation ladder

8. SCALING
- Split triggers: 15+ members, 20+ hrs/week management time
- 6-week split process: Identify → Prepare → Transition → Execute
- Post-split connection maintenance
- Target 8-12 members per PSN post-split

9. CỬU ĐỊA MASTERY
- 9 levels từ Phân Phân đến Vô Song
- Scoring algorithm: 5 weighted components
- Action triggers: 🟢🟡🔴 thresholds
- Dashboard: daily scan, weekly review, monthly analysis

LEADERSHIP READINESS SELF-ASSESSMENT:

Rate yourself 1-5 on each:

[ ] Tôi có thể set PSN vision và communicate rõ ràng
[ ] Tôi có thể run weekly meetings mà không cần prepare quá nhiều
[ ] Tôi có thể identify và address underperformance early
[ ] Tôi có thể have difficult conversations với empathy
[ ] Tôi có thể celebrate wins authentically (không phải forced)
[ ] Tôi có thể make data-driven decisions under pressure
[ ] Tôi có thể delegate và trust team members
[ ] Tôi có thể resolve conflicts without taking sides
[ ] Tôi có thể inspire people mặc dù không có authority
[ ] Tôi có thể admit mistakes và learn publicly

Score: ___/50
30-50: Emerging leader — keep learning, practice skills
35-40: Competent leader — ready for M8 Coaching
40-50: Strong leader — ready to develop sub-leaders

90-DAY PSN PLAN (Template):

MONTH 1 (Days 1-30):
- Implement all systems learned in M7
- Run first 4 structured weekly meetings
- Set up buddy system for all new members
- Reach Cửu Địa Level 4 (Kị Kị)
- Revenue target: ___ triệu
- New members: ___

MONTH 2 (Days 31-60):
- Deepen member development: advanced training
- Identify and develop 1-2 sub-leaders
- Run first PIP if needed
- Reach Cửu Địa Level 5 (Tranh Tranh)
- Revenue target: ___ triệu
- New members: ___

MONTH 3 (Days 61-90):
- Leadership delegation: sub-leaders running meetings
- PSN culture fully established
- Evaluate split readiness if PSN > 15 members
- Reach Cửu Địa Level 6 (Nghi Nghi)
- Revenue target: ___ triệu
- New members: ___

TRANSITION TO M8:

M8 (Coaching Conversations) builds directly on M7:
- M7 taught you HOW to manage PSN
- M8 teaches you HOW to develop PEOPLE
- Coaching = taking PSN management to the next level
- In M8, you'll learn: GROW model, active listening, powerful questioning, DISC-based coaching

M8 prerequisite: You must be actively running a PSN (have at least 5 members) before starting M8. If you don't have a PSN yet, focus on recruitment (M5) and PSN setup (M7) until you do.

Action items:
1. Complete leadership readiness self-assessment
2. Write 90-day PSN plan using the template above
3. Schedule M8 start date (after you have 5+ members in PSN)
4. Practice: Run your next PSN meeting using the full 60-min structure
